description: This file contains the AuthService class that provides authentication-related functionalities such as user registration and login within a multi-tenant system. It interacts with a database module and utility functions for password hashing, comparison, and JWT signing.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides methods for user registration and login, managing user data within tenants and handling authentication processes.

methods.name: register({ tenantId, email, password, name, roles = ['admin'] })
methods.description: Registers a new user within a specified tenant. Sets the first user with an 'admin' role by default and prevents duplicate email registrations.

methods.name: login({ tenantId, email, password, companyId = null })
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, generates a JWT token, and optionally associates the user with a company within a tenant.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^  async login({ tenantId, email, password, companyId = null }) {$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^  async register({ tenantId, email, password, name, roles = ['admin'] }) {$/
